groups.rationale: Reviewed the merged architecture overview and source-derived system topology after integrating trunk localization and guest matrix work; the Windows custodian and native guest verification boundaries are represented, while runtime and physical gaps remain explicit.

Reviewed merged Marshall source, localization catalog migration, terminal budget watcher, editor custody integration and handbook chapters; current authority, presentation, transport and recovery boundaries are documented with incomplete native/browser acceptance retained.

Reviewed merged protocol and SSH/catalog changes against guest manifests, transport identity and execution authority; shared codecs remain closed and native admission stays fail-closed, with focused protocol evidence recorded.

Reviewed merged Lilly and native guest deployment changes against host-local ownership, storage, gateway and recovery chapters; no unsupported native admission or public guest transport was introduced.

Reviewed merged service source and generated catalogs against service topology and authority chapters; Android and editor verification additions remain scoped evidence and do not change fleet listener ownership.

Reviewed merged Nix, fleet, guest catalog and image constructor changes against deployment and recovery chapters; OmniOS and Windows candidate promotion remain explicit opt-ins with transport and browser gaps fail-closed.

Reviewed merged ADR, HLDD, contract, localization and receipt changes; renamed Windows custodian ADR-0208 and upstream catalog governance are linked, with incomplete runtime and translation evidence retained.
